evals.prompt: Create a portable diagnostic-json skill from the supplied brief. Make it useful for engineers inspecting malformed JSON Lines exports. Stage the complete package for review; preserve the input and do not deploy. Supply a file map and report exactly what you verified.
evals.expected_output: A coherent staged package with actionable activation boundaries, complete reference guidance, a generic language selector, accurate source context and a review report. The malformed sample is recognized at line two without inventing a fix or changing the original.
assertions: All four required root folders exist with no duplicated area scaffolding.
SKILL.md has supported frontmatter and the three profile sections in order.
Every reference has at most 100 physical lines, including catalogs.
The diagnostic example identifies the malformed second record and preserves original data.
Language routing lists no nonexistent translations.
Source mapping, atomic file tasks and verification results are provided.
No live skill or external service was modified.

evals.prompt: Repair this spectrum-analyzer skill fixture. Its repeated folders, hash filenames and sweep examples look damaged. Use the accompanying captured source contract, retain distinct guide/API material, and preserve valid behavior and licensing. Stage your correction and explain the evidence and testing limits.
evals.expected_output: A complete staged skill with subject-based paths, descriptive filenames, repaired comment/newline structure, the documented sweep property, clear initialization requirements and preserved MARK/DELT2 behavior. The report distinguishes source evidence, syntax/mocks and hardware tests.
assertions: No repeated ancestor names or hash-suffixed reference filenames remain.
Guide and API contract content remain distinct and reachable.
Area assets/scripts/evals placeholders are absent and root scaffolding is correct.
The example uses continuous_sweep_enabled with intact newlines and initialized fsl context.
The license is byte-identical and the valid DELT2 default is retained.
Every source file has a disposition and all changed outputs have prepared tasks.
The report does not claim hardware execution or a fresh source fetch without evidence.

evals.prompt: Build the data-utilities collection from this brief, with two explicitly recognized product skills. Prepare and stage it. Then explain and demonstrate in disposable files how you handle the stated resume event: a changed input and approval for a different candidate. Do not deploy anything live.
evals.expected_output: Reachable product skills with correctly scoped reference trees and root folders, full prepared records, and a resume demonstration that preserves the owner edit and refuses the mismatched approval. Requirements and mutable progress are separate.
assertions: The collection routes through its references to both declared product skills.
Only explicitly declared product roots receive the four-folder template.
All product routes, catalogs and local fragments resolve.
Input drift is detected before candidate application and the owner edit is preserved.
An approval digest for different bytes cannot authorize deployment.
No old prepared work is replayed over a newer revision.
The handoff records frozen requirements, current artifact hashes, completed outcomes and the next authorized action.
